items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 58:1
items.html: There are many reasons for this: The first is because of the progenitors, namely YESHSUT, since YESHSUT need to attain their Gadlut and unite with AVI into one Partzuf, for there is no impregnation of ZA except in YESHSUT, and specifically at the time when the Rosh of Yisrael Saba and Tevunah joins the lower third of the Tifferet of AVI into a single phase, and the Partzuf as a whole receives the degree of AB SAG, as is known. The second reason is that the beginning of the root of ZON begins only through the annulment of the Parsa by force of the drop of the coupling of AB SAG of AK, as it was in the secret of Vav and a dot of the Yesod of AK, which influenced AVI of Nekudim, this being the root of ZON, from the aspect of the AHP of the NHY of AK that went out to BYA at the time of the second restriction. And the third reason is, in order to give birth to the Katnut of ZA, so that it will have the aspect of the engraving and the lack of the illumination of Hochma, in such a way that it will be fit to receive the aspect of Hochma at the time of its Gadlut, as written in Answer 142, that Katnut and Gadlut must be of one kind.
